verdict.rationale: RingCentral advertises first-party MCP servers and connecting RingCentral to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, which suggests users can operate it through natural-language prompts in an AI client. The evidence is only headline-level and gives no detail on which actions can be performed. The AI Receptionist and agentic voice features serve callers and customer interactions, not users operating the product, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of which product operations are exposed to natural-language control, depth and scope of the MCP tools, any native in-app natural-language command interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
